variety_description: Exceedingly high yielding, medium maturity, medium tall, medium long slender variety suitable for transplanted under irrigated lowland conditions in Boro season. Developed by BINA and released in 2012 for planting in saline prone areas. Sturdy stem with erect plant type. Lodging and shattering tolerant. Moderately tolerant to major diseases and insect pests.
